#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    string s;
    cin >> n >> s;
    bool openParenthesis = false;
    string sb;
    int maxOutSide = 0;
    int nbrInside = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        char c = s[i];
        switch (c) {
            case '(':
                if (!openParenthesis) {
                    stringstream ss(sb);
                    string word;
                    while (getline(ss, word, '_')) {
                        maxOutSide = max(maxOutSide, (int)word.length());
                    }
                }
                openParenthesis = true;
                sb.clear();
                break;
            case ')':
                openParenthesis = false;
                {
                    stringstream ss(sb);
                    string word;
                    while (getline(ss, word, '_')) {
                        if (!word.empty()) {
                            nbrInside++;
                        }
                    }
                }
                sb.clear();
                break;
            default:
                sb.push_back(c);
                break;
        }
    }
    {
        stringstream ss(sb);
        string word;
        while (getline(ss, word, '_')) {
            maxOutSide = max(maxOutSide, (int)word.length());
        }
    }
    cout << maxOutSide << " " << nbrInside << endl;
    return 0;
}
